_note: the author's rulings on the location pool (2026-09-15), applied by tools/build/build_location_pool.py after the wiki harvest and by the resolver's alias map: `discard` leaves the pool; `alias` maps a typed word to the pool place that stands for it (a discarded name may keep an alias); `rename` moves a wiki name to the booru's tag; `parent` gives a small measured place the tables (garments, related, lifts) of the place it specialises; `add` puts a booru tag the wiki page never listed into the pool with its kind. `typed_only` on an added place: measured and typed, never rolled (hair salon, 2026-09-15: 'salon' is the hair salon, not the saloon). `genres`: a place rolled only inside those genre leaves (slums: dark fantasy, horror -- 2026-09-15). `floor`: a pool place under this many posts is typed-only unless it carries `genres` (the small-tag places ruling). `generic`: a place word with no pool place of its own ('room', 'house', 'street') is the typed place with the stated kind -- the roll never overrides it with a city (2026-09-15).

saloon.note: added on a misreading of 'salon' (2026-09-15); kept as a measured place, parent tavern
